name: DARE to Dream Summer Day Program
operator_name: DARE to Dream Summer Day Program
description_short: A one-week summer day program in Massachusetts for children in grades 3–6 that teaches personal safety, social media awareness and healthy decision-making. Days mix field activities, arts and crafts, safety demonstrations and field trips, usually from 9am to 2pm.
activities: field trips (Southwick Zoo, Sweatt Beach, Water Wizz, PINZ)
minor league baseball games (Brockton Rox / Worcester Bravehearts)
swim_waterfront_notes: Field trips include Sweatt Beach and Water Wizz (water park). The page gives no details on swim supervision or swim tests.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page shows the summer 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). The 2027 dates have not been posted.
The only address given is a PO Box in Wrentham, MA. It is a mailing address, not necessarily where the program meets.
Start and end times can change for evening field trips or presenters. Parents are told to check the website for changes.
Grade is based on the grade the child attended in the 2025-26 school year.
Registrations made after May 31 are charged a late fee. The fee amount is not stated.
unknowns: Physical location where the program meets
Whether meals or lunch are included
Transportation to and from camp (buses are mentioned only for field trips)
